tests.title: matrix: every documented capability, every role
admin has no clinical-record access; notes.view is never granted by a designation
can(): A needs the caseload, D needs the designation, unknown role/capability/user fail closed
routes: every registry route has a capability entry; each role opens exactly what the matrix allows
every action has a capability entry (and nothing is declared for an action that does not exist)
anonymous: /api/state, /api/do (admin and plain actions), /files and the roster
no screening transcript reaches an unauthenticated caller: /api/state is 401, the roster is empty, the scripted call needs a session
a made-up or tampered token is the same as no token
action sweep: every action x every staff role gets 401/403 exactly when the matrix says no
presenter controls need presenter mode, not only a role
user.update: a role change is presenter-only; designations go through two people
projection: direct support sees only their caseload; no screenings, drafts, versions, fills, other staff notes
projection: admin sees unit balances and authorization status but no clinical text
projection: supervisor sees status and their reviewees' notes; clinician sees clinical text
a role switch changes what the API returns (same server, different token)
service line: outpatient (P.G., R-0377) never appears in the staff state
portal sessions: a guardian sees one child; a school user sees their own school; neither can use staff actions
files need a session and the right role
cross-origin: JSON only and an origin allow-list on state-changing calls
presenter PIN and DEMO_PRESENTER are honoured by sign-in
a plain sign-in is never a presenter; the public roster says whether presenter mode exists and needs a PIN, and never carries the PIN
createSession: PIN required when PRESENTER_PIN is set (wrong or missing is 403 with pin flag), the right PIN elevates, DEMO_PRESENTER=0 never does
regression (URA-05/06/10): writing localStorage.psyflo_user, or reloading, never turns a role session into another person or a presenter
with PRESENTER_PIN set: the server and the dock ask for the PIN, a wrong PIN is refused, the right PIN unlocks the presenter tools (own server)
WPS-03 a clinician opening the phone app acts as the clinician (own caseload), never as another person
WPS-04 a student off the caseload cannot be opened on the phone: "not on your list. Nothing was opened."
WPS-06 direct support opens another staffer's student in Lauris: the panel says the student is not on the caseload and offers no draft
WPS-07 the panel always shows an identity card (initials, Harvest #, school) before it offers anything; a page whose initials disagree is a hard stop (see enhance)
WPS-09 / DSL-01 the panel is off for an outpatient (#4300) and a SEBS (#5120) record: nothing read, nothing typed
ICE-01 a non-scripted screening transcript drafts nothing it was not told; the missing boxes are listed as questions and "Nothing invented" is not a vacuous PASS
ICE-03 M.R. continued stay: every count equals the stored rows (40 daily notes), the constants 21 and 61 do not exist, gaps print "Evidence missing
ICE-04 an initial SRA drafted without the school's numbers or the screening facts does not draft criterion 1 (no frequency, duration, intensity or office-referral counts that nobody gave)
ICE-05 a discharge draft with no stored plan writes no event as done (no date after today)
ICE-06 a dictation that names no objective, time or intervention gets questions, and no objective is inserted
ICE-08 a quarterly draft for a client with no stored notes is blank with "Evidence missing", never another student's numbers
UAR-01 the drafted narrative adds nothing the staffer did not say ("We played basketball at recess a…"); "observed" is flagged and the text is not rewritten
UAR-02 the drafted narrative adds nothing the staffer did not say ("He ran laps and was frustrated w…"); "observed" is flagged and the text is not rewritten
UAR-03 the drafted narrative adds nothing the staffer did not say ("I observed her at lunch and she …"); "observed" is flagged and the text is not rewritten
UAR-04 no predicted success percentages, research citations or outcome promises in any drafting source
UAR-05 every box of every draft type (continued stay, quarterly, initial request) cites sources that resolve to a stored record
UAR-05b (not release-blocking) every source chip of those drafts carries a date
UAR-07 "Good recommendation" / "Needs improvement" are stored with who and when and are visible to a clinician, not to direct support
EFN-09 there is no addendum or late-entry path to a processed record: no action, no control, every write route refuses a processed session
MCS-08 a consent cannot be signed by a typed name or by staff: no token is 401, staff is 403; the signer is the guardian behind the link
MCS-10 an appeal cannot be signed or sent for a request that is not denied (R-0402 is a partial): guardian and staff are refused, and no "faxed" event appears
URA-01 direct support opening Authorizations is told the screen is not available for the role (no data)
URA-03 the administrator opening a continued-stay form in Lauris: "Not permitted. The administrator role has no clinical-record access."
URA-04 the administrator is denied Referrals and Eligibility; Analytics for the administrator is aggregates only (no patient rows)
URA-05 a role cannot be taken by writing localStorage: with direct support signed in, setting psyflo_user=dowens must not turn the page into the administrator
URA-11 a guardian page needs its link: with no session and no token, #/ParentProgress?c=DW shows no child
PDU-03 an overdue request gets a notice DRAFTED for a person to send; nothing is sent until a person presses it, and the send says simulated with the person as actor
PDU-04 the overdue-notice action does not assert a rule as law: no "Under the 7-calendar-day…", no statute or regulation cited as settled
PDU-05 a change to the decision window moves every dependent date (the overdue state and the decision day of a sent request) because they come from the rules table
PDU-07 an information request states its due time and that the hours are calendar hours (a Friday 5 pm request is due Saturday), with a source chip
IIU-01 / IIU-02 the unit bands: 60, 90, 119 minutes = 0 units; 120 and 179 = 1; 180 and 299 = 2; 300 = 3
IIU-07 an authorization that is used up (65 of 65) carries ONE exhaustion date that is not in the future
IIU-08 D.W.'s early-discharge dates agree across the authorization transition, the drafted discharge and the Lauris discharge panel
IIU-10 time blocks marked not direct (lunch, transport) never count as direct time
IIU-11 the mock Lauris warns or refuses a daily note when no units are available (T.N. 0 left) or after the authorization end date
EXA-02 the renewal due date follows the rule (end date minus 14 business days), not the end date itself
EXA-03 an exhausted authorization (T.N.) says service continues unpaid or that no units are left, with a date and an owner
EXA-05 an eligibility re-check that is due appears in My Work (Do next) once the recheck interval has passed
EXA-06 services after a lapse of more than 31 days are flagged for discharge review
tests.note: NOT-RUNNABLE: the 31-day rule (discharge.lapse_days, officially verified) is displayed text in the transition section only; no queue, banner or My Work line flags a lapse

tests.title: DSL-05 a school user cannot share an update about a student of another school; nothing is stored
DSL-06 no SEBS or outpatient referral or client reaches Psyflo's state for any staff role (every referral is for TDT; no H.B. or P.G.)
DSL-07 a counselor update is held back when no signed school release is on file: the monthly collateral panel says "No signed school release" and does not file it as a contact
SVR-02 no "faxed" or "sent" event exists unless the Send stub ran and returned a reference: overdue notice, information reply by fax on an Availity payer, appeal signing
SVR-03 the DMAS lookup page says it is a mock; the portals (Availity, state incident portal) are labelled as mock pages

SVR-04 the "How the data gets in" text actually served claims no AI rewrite, OCR read-back, Sfax API or Availity reading that does not exist; the Lauris wording is "page bridge", never "Lauris API" as a capability
SVR-05 the speech-to-text control says where the audio goes and that the data is synthetic, before any microphone use
SVR-07 no stored credentials, tokens or unattended payer or Lauris sessions: no secret literals, no browser automation, no scheduled submission in the product code
SVR-09 demo controls (reply, advance, reset) are hidden from direct support in the UI and refused by the server

URA-10 / SVR-09 a direct-support browser session is never a presenter: after a page reload it holds no demo controls, no dock, and the server refuses demo.advanceDay and request.demoReply (three attempts: the escalation is a race with the page's own sign-in)
URA-06 a direct-support user cannot promote themselves: user.update {role:admin} needs the administrator capability AND a presenter, never a presenter alone
